# Diataxis Reference Files

These files are used by the `docs-review.yml` GitHub Actions workflow to provide
Claude with detailed Diataxis documentation framework guidance when reviewing PRs.

Source: [Diataxis Framework](https://diataxis.fr/)

## Files

- `diataxis-summary.md` — Overview of the framework, compass, and key distinctions
- `tutorials.md` — Principles for tutorial documentation
- `how-to-guides.md` — Principles for how-to guide documentation
- `reference.md` — Principles for reference documentation
- `explanation.md` — Principles for explanation documentation
